thread:
maria: Quick heads-up — planning to create release/1.16 tomorrow 08:00 PT. Need owners for: version bump, changelog polish, and cherry-pick triage.

alex: I can own cherry-pick triage for infra/runtime PRs. Will monitor the PR queue an hour before cut. :eyes:

sam: I’ll take package bumps and publishing tasks (npm/pypi). Will open the version bump PR tonight.

kevin: Small policy question — do we allow non-bugfix backports (perf tweaks) into the release branch? Our current doc only allows bugfix/critical fixes.

maria: Good call. Proposal: keep default to bugfix/critical only. Allow perf tweaks if they are <=1 file and have an e2e perf regression test. Tag them with `backport/exception` and require two approvers. Thoughts?

alex: +1 on exception flow. Can we add an automated checklist item to require the perf test? Otherwise we'll get sneak-in changes.

sam: Agree. Also reminder — update CHANGELOG.md under Unreleased with short blurb. Example:
```
- Fix: reduce KV cache miss spike under heavy load (alex)
- Perf: faster batch allocator on A100 (kevin) — backport/exception
```

maria: Perfect. For branch creation, ops will run the canonical command:
```bash
git checkout -b release/1.16
git push origin release/1.16
```
After branch exists, we mark PRs with `needs-backport` -> `backport-requested` when owners ask.

kevin: One logistical ask — can we freeze `main` merges 30m before cut for any large refactors? We had a flaky test last release.

maria: Yes, let's do a soft freeze at T-30m for >500 LOC or >1-file formatting changes. Small docs/typo merges OK. I'll post the reminder in #general 15m before.

release-bot: Reminder scheduled — creating branch release/1.16 at 2024-10-05T15:00:00Z (operator: maria). Trigger will post in this thread when done.

alex: For cherry-picks, prefer: `git cherry-pick -x <sha>` and include `Backport: release/1.16` in the PR body. I'll review infra picks asap.

sam: One more: who will run the smoke deploy on dedicated after branch cut? I can schedule the smoke window 20m after cut.

maria: Thanks — sam will run smoke. alex triages picks. kevin tags exception backports. I'll do the changelog sign-off. Ping here if you need help. :thumbsup:

kevin: I'll start labeling candidate PRs and add short rationales for any exception ask.

maria: Great — if nobody objects I’ll proceed with the create tomorrow. Otherwise speak up here.

alex: No objections from me.

sam: All good.

kevin: fine by me.

release-bot: Branch release/1.16 created (sha: abc1234). Posting branch link: https://repo.internal/redwood/release/1.16

maria: Branch is up — starting the backport sweep. Please add `backport/approved` label when a picked PR is validated.

alex: Picking infra/queue-fix#842 -> cherry-picked and pushed as 9f8e7a. PR: https://repo.internal/redwood/pull/927 (added backport/approved).

sam: Bumped package versions and opened PR for release notes: https://repo.internal/redwood/pull/928

kevin: Submitted perf tweak with tests; requested two approvers. Marked `backport/exception`.

maria: Thanks team — leaving this thread open for any late backport asks. If you need to escalate, DM me.
